scripts.dev: concurrently --names client,server --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.start: concurrently --names client,server --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run start:client" "npm run start:server"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:server
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:client && npm run lint:fix:server
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
